title: Cookie Policy – ThePaymaster®
heading: Cookie Policy
body:
Our Commitment to Transparency

At ThePaymaster®, we believe in being clear about how we collect and use data. This Cookie Policy explains how we use cookies and similar technologies on our website (https://thepaymaster.co.uk) to help deliver the best possible experience for our users.

Understanding Cookies

A cookie is a small text file that our website stores on your computer or mobile device when you visit us. These files help our website remember information about your visit, which can both make it easier to use our site and help us improve our service.

Types of Technologies We Use

  1. Cookies: Small text files stored on your device
  2. Scripts: Code that helps our website function properly
  3. Web Beacons: Small, invisible elements that help us understand how our site is used

How We Use Cookies

Essential Technical Cookies

These cookies are necessary for our website to function properly. They help with basic features like:

  • Keeping you logged in during your visit
  • Remembering your preferences
  • Ensuring secure access to your information

These essential cookies are always active as they’re fundamental to the website’s operation.

Statistics Cookies

We use these cookies to understand how visitors interact with our website by:

  • Collecting anonymous usage data
  • Analysing which pages are most frequently visited
  • Identifying how users navigate our site

We’ll always ask for your consent before placing these cookies.

Marketing Cookies

These cookies help us:

  • Understand your interests
  • Deliver relevant content
  • Measure the effectiveness of our communications

We only use these with your explicit consent.

Cookie Management

Your Control

You can manage cookies in several ways:

  • Browser Settings: Control cookies through your browser’s privacy settings
  • Consent Preferences: Update your choices through our cookie consent tool
  • Manual Deletion: Remove cookies through your browser settings

Please note that disabling certain cookies may affect website functionality.

Your Privacy Rights

Under UK data protection law, you have several rights regarding your personal data:

  • Access: View what data we hold about you
  • Correction: Update inaccurate information
  • Deletion: Request removal of your data
  • Objection: Contest how we process your data
  • Portability: Request transfer of your data
  • Consent Withdrawal: Change your mind about data processing

Contact UsFor any questions about our Cookie Policy or privacy practices:

Email: info@thepaymaster.co.uk

Updates to This Policy

We regularly review and update this policy to reflect changes in our practices and services. We’ll notify you of any significant changes through our website or direct communication.

Last updated: December 2024
